You'll know this simple dessert is done baking when it smells just delightful.|Cooking (Interface)|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Egg Tarts can be made in a [[Cooking Pot]] by combining [[Tabantha Wheat]], a [[Bird Egg]], [[Cane Sugar]], and [[Goat Butter]]. When eaten, they will restore four of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s, though they can also be sold for 30 [[Rupee]]s. It is said that one knows when this dish is done baking due to its delightful smell. By adding a fifth [[Ingredient]], different variations of Egg Tarts can be made: * '''Hearty Egg Tart''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Egg Tart}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum heart.
You'll know this simple dessert is done baking when it smells just delightful.|Inventory|BotW}} Eating one will completely restore Link's missing Hearts, in addition to temporarily increasing his maximum Hearts. They can be sold for 50 Rupees. * '''Energizing Egg Tart''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Egg Tart}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
You'll know this simple dessert is done baking when it smells just delightful.|Inventory|BotW}} If eaten, these will restore a portion of Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. They will also heal him for five Hearts and are worth 50 Rupees when sold. * '''Enduring Egg Tart''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Egg Tart}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
You'll know this simple dessert is done baking when it smells just delightful.|Inventory|BotW}} Eating one of these dishes will completely refill Link's Stamina Wheel and temporarily increase his maximum [[Stamina]]. They also restore six of his Hearts and sell for 50 Rupees. * '''Hasty Egg Tart''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Egg Tart}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
You'll know this simple dessert is done baking when it smells just delightful.|Inventory|BotW}} These tarts temporarily boosts Link's movement speed. They will also heal him for five Hearts, and they can be sold for 50 Rupees. * '''Spicy Egg Tart''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Egg Tart}}
Grants a low-level cold resistance.
You'll know this simple dessert is done baking when it smells just delightful.|Inventory|BotW}} When eaten, they will temporarily increase Link's [[Cold Resistance]] for one level. They will also heal him for five Hearts and sell for 50 Rupees. * '''Electro Egg Tart''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Egg Tart}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
You'll know this simple dessert is done baking when it smells just delightful.|Inventory|BotW}} If they are eaten, they will temporarily increase Link's [[Shock Resistance]]. They also heal him for five Hearts, and they sell for 50 Rupees. * '''Mighty Egg Tart''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Egg Tart}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
You'll know this simple dessert is done baking when it smells just delightful.|Inventory|BotW}} Eating one will temporarily boost Link's attack power. They will also heal five of his Hearts, and they sell for 50 Rupees. * '''Tough Egg Tart''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Egg Tart}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
You'll know this simple dessert is done baking when it smells just delightful.|Inventory|BotW}} They grant a temporary [[Defense]] boost when eaten. They restore five of Link's Hearts to his Life Gauge and are worth 50 Rupees when sold. * '''Sneaky Egg Tart''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Egg Tart}}
Grants a mid-level stealth boost.
You'll know this simple dessert is done baking when it smells just delightful.|Inventory|BotW}} Eating them will temporarily increase Link's [[Stealth]]. They also heal him for five Hearts and sell for 50 Rupees. * '''Chilly Egg Tart''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Egg Tart}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
You'll know this simple dessert is done baking when it smells just delightful.|Inventory|BotW}} If they are eaten, these tarts will temporarily increase Link's [[Heat Resistance]] by one level. They will also heal four of his Hearts, and they sell for 50 Rupees. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} Egg Tarts return from {{BotW}}. Their [[Recipe]] remains unchanged, requiring [[Link]] to [[Cooking|Cook]] a [[Bird Egg]], [[Cane Sugar]], [[Goat Butter]], and [[Tabantha Wheat]] together. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} The [[Recipe]] for Egg Tart is obtained by completing the [[Scenario]] "[[When Courage Fails]]". It is made using two [[Bird Egg]]s, two [[Tabantha Wheat]]s, two [[Cane Sugar]]s, and two [[Goat Butter]]s. Through the completion of the [[Quest]] "[[Hungry Hunches]]", however, the number of each required ingredient can be reduced to one. Preparing an Egg Tart before a [[Challenge]] or [[Scenario]] will increase the drop rate of [[Material]]s by 15%. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Egg Tart Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Egg Tart icon ==See Also== {{See Also| * Egg Pudding * Food }} {{ref}} {{Categories |Desserts, Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
